scope: Labelled origin supplements for January calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs listed reviewed January histories without origin wording; r151-data.mjs + build-r151.mjs (round 139–149 helpers, new LT2/LTW templates) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r151.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. The reviewed history stays first; the supplement follows with the translated Hypothesis label. Glosses that repeat their word are removed. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
